Bio: A team originally from the mountain passes, consisting exclusively of AE86-series machinery. While their standing on the Shuto Expressway was initially modest, their roster has recently surged and they are actively expanding their presence.
A recently formed squad founded on the pure concept of driving for the sheer joy of it. Thanks to their welcoming and accessible atmosphere, numerous newcomers can be found among their ranks.
A team comprised solely of 4-door sport sedans. Although on friendly terms with MAX RACING, who share an identical concept, they are generally outmatched in terms of overall squad firepower.

Formed by members working at the French restaurant 'La Liberté'. Not only are they exacting about table etiquette, but they are equally strict about road manners, known for their polished and impeccably courteous driving.
Every single member drives an all-black sport wagon. Founded by a wealthy leader purely as a leisure indulgence, beneath their unassuming exteriors lies deep, high-spec tuning.

A team built around the S13, S14, and S15 chassis. Although they claim to uphold good road manners, the very act of drifting across the Shuto Expressway makes them quite a nuisance to other motorists.

A lightweight K-car crew based in northern Kanto. Hardened by countless intensive runs on mountain passes, their technical prowess is exceptional. They hone their craft daily in secluded sectors deserted by other teams.
While their name sounds like an all-female team, they are in reality a squad of shallow playboys driven by the sole desire to pick up girls. They hold zero genuine dedication toward driving craft.
Named after the concept of the loop expressway as a boxing ring. Their competitive caliber is exceptionally high; to earn a spot on the roster, an applicant must defeat an active member in battle.

A squad exclusively composed of front-wheel-drive (FF) cars. Their name is derived from the sharp, razor-like cornering characteristic of FF platforms. However, the overall competitive level of the team remains relatively modest.
A team that directly took its name from a university automobile enthusiasts' club. While members hail from various colleges, a closer look reveals that some among them are no longer even students...
Close companions of SS LIMITED, this squad brings together heavily tuned 4-door sport sedans. Their creed is bold, exhilarating driving powered by high-output tuned saloon engines.
A team that does not enforce a unified chassis code in order to showcase individual character. Nevertheless, their lineup boasts numerous high-performance platforms with formidable baseline specs.

A crew brought together by a feature project in an automotive magazine. Although packed with fiercely distinctive drivers, their complete lack of prior acquaintance means they get along quite poorly behind the scenes.
A team centered entirely around rotary powerhouses—the FD and FC chassis. As their name suggests, they earned their moniker from the rhythmic, dance-like way they twist through corners.

A team that nominally accepts anyone provided their car is fitted with CATZ fog lights, yet somehow their chassis selection is curiously uniform. Make no mistake: the driving skill of their members is remarkably high.

A squad that naturally formed as drivers who cruise purely for pleasure rather than fierce competition began clustering together. Consequently, their internal organizational cohesion remains quite loose.
A squad composed primarily of compact, lightweight machinery. Operating as an elite, tight-knit vanguard, their roster has seen zero member turnover for several years.

A collective of die-hard music obsessives who tear through the night with bass blasting at maximum volume. Their ability to saw at the steering wheel in perfect sync with the beat is nothing short of an art form.
A team formed by individuals carrying troubled, shadowed pasts. Their name embodies a collective yearning to feel as free and pure as the fresh wind whenever they take to the asphalt.

A visual-kei styling team fiercely obsessed with flawless aero and outward aesthetics. While they pursue head-turning coolness above pure speed, their behind-the-wheel abilities are surprisingly formidable.

A squad composed entirely of performance wagons. They are pushing hard toward their ambitious goal of igniting a wagon revolution on the Shuto Expressway. With rising fame, their membership is expanding rapidly.

Every member pilots an all-wheel-drive GC8 chassis. Boasting many drivers with rally backgrounds, they operate as a solid mid-tier force. They maintain a fierce, bitter rivalry with TOP LEVEL, who share a similar lineup.
A crew whose mission is to cultivate each member into a fully independent, self-reliant street racer. They emphasize personal accountability and conscientious self-discipline out on the road.

A mixed crew uniting sport sedans and purebred sports cars. Founded two years ago, they once teetered on the brink of complete disbandment, making their enduring survival their greatest point of pride.

A crew composed entirely of foreign racers who challenge anyone and everyone the moment they spot another street racer. True to their name, they blaze across the highway in complete disregard of all traffic laws.
A massive team centered around the AE86 platform. The 'R' in their team name is taken from 'Racing'.
An all-female racing syndicate. Armed with serious driving pedigree and a fierce, dedicated mindset toward racing, they command genuine respect from every rival crew across the capital.
A crew formed by car enthusiasts residing across Tokyo. While their chassis selection is completely disjointed and varied, every single driver loves running the Shuto Expressway above all else.
Former teammates who once tore up the streets together, reuniting under the banner of mutual trust. Their team name is derived directly from the word TRUST.
A squad composed of former rally drivers piloting all-wheel-drive CE, CP, and CN platforms. They stand as bitter, sworn adversaries to ANOTHER STAR, who share an identical rally-bred philosophy.

A team revolving around R32, R33, and R34 Skyline GT-Rs. Because of their reputation for violent, muscle-flexing driving that relies entirely on sheer horsepower, they are widely detested by other street racers.
A crew that interprets 'DRY' not as sterile or dull, but as being free from grasping greed and petty rivalry, cruising the night solely for relaxed, unburdened enjoyment.
A squad assembled from massive, heavy-bodied vehicles. Wielding the brutal, unrestrained muscle squeezed from large-displacement engines, they storm the Shuto Expressway with relentless momentum.
A team founded by service personnel stationed at US military bases in Japan. While they carry a disciplined image, out on the asphalt all formalities vanish and rank ceases to exist.
A brand-new squad established by a legendary figure hailed ten years ago as one of the Shuto's 'Four Heavenly Kings', answering the impassioned call of his old asphalt comrades.
A crew comprised of machinery built with an uncompromising emphasis on cornering capability. True to their name, they pursue boundless, limitless driving unconstrained by arbitrary barriers.
Much like TWISTER, this is a team built exclusively on rotary sports cars. The 'R' in their name stands doubly for 'Rotary' and 'Revolution'.
A syndicate assembled by Chinese racers living in Japan. Every member commands high-power machinery, and their organizational cohesion and unity as a team are exceptionally tight.
A professional racing team secretly backed under strict corporate confidentiality by a complete-car tuning manufacturer with a 13-year history. They target the Wangan line exclusively.
A stern, unyielding brotherhood that strictly forbids female members. Forsaking flashy visual flair to pursue nothing but absolute speed, their technical caliber as a unit is exceptionally high.

In both name and reality, the undisputed strongest squad on the modern Shuto Expressway. However, when it comes to victory, they are also the lowest, most vile syndicate who will shamelessly resort to any dirty trick to win.
Short for 'Adventure Planning Service', a gathering of cheerful optimists who enthusiastically take on anything interesting. They strictly avoid reckless driving.
A diverse coalition of speed enthusiasts residing across the greater Tokyo metropolis. Their roster spans programmers, teachers, car-loving high school girls, and everything in between.
The aspirational pinnacle of the Shuto Expressway racing scene. Rumored to be the undisputed strongest syndicate in Tokyo, they have gathered a collection of deeply eccentric, unmatched virtuosos.
